claims.evidence: Witness photos show gas cylinders (yellow/blue) with valves and stickers, but do not show the capacity marking (12.5kg), gas type (LPG vs other), or any readable label/inspection details.

risks.risk: Gas type may not be LPG cooking gas (could be another gas), which affects compatibility and safety.
risks.proof: A clear close-up of the cylinder label/sticker showing the gas type (e.g., LPG/propane/butane) and any hazard markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown gas cylinder (worst-case for buyer safety/compatibility), not as cooking LPG.

risks.risk: Capacity may not be 12.5kg (could be smaller/larger), affecting value.
risks.proof: A clear shot of the capacity marking (e.g., '12.5kg' or stamped tare/net weight) on the cylinder body.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not-confirmed capacity (worst-case value), treating it as potentially smaller.

risks.risk: Remaining gas content/pressure is unknown; cylinder may be near-empty.
risks.proof: A video/clip showing the cylinder gauge/indicator if present, or a recent refill receipt/scan showing fill level/last refill date.

risks.risk: Valve condition and leak risk are unknown; dents/scuffs could indicate damage to valve seating or threads.
risks.proof: A close-up of the valve threads and valve face plus a short leak test clip (e.g., soapy water bubble test around valve/regulator connection).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially leaking/valve-damaged (worst-case), assuming it may require replacement/repair.

risks.risk: Regulator/hose compatibility and whether they are included/working is unknown.
risks.proof: Photos/clip of the regulator/hose (if included) showing brand/model and connection type, plus a quick functional check.
risks.if_unproven: Price without assuming regulator/hose are included or usable.

risks.risk: Certification/inspection markings and expiry are unknown; an expired cylinder may be rejected by refill stations.
risks.proof: A clear photo of inspection/certification stamps and expiry date/markings on the cylinder.

risks.risk: Cylinder ownership/traceability/refill history is unknown; some cylinders may be problematic to refill or may be stolen/unauthorized.
risks.proof: Any documentation or markings that show ownership/traceability (e.g., company stamp, refill history card/receipt).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the cylinder label/sticker showing gas type (LPG) and capacity marking (12.5kg).
Photo of stamped/printed tare/net weight and any '12.5kg' marking on the body.
Close-up of the valve threads and valve connection area (front and side).
Short clip showing a soapy-water leak test around the valve/regulator connection (no bubbles).
If a regulator/hose is included: clear photos showing the regulator model/connection type and a quick functional check.
Photo of inspection/certification stamps and expiry date/markings.
Any refill receipt/card or traceability/ownership documentation.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a gas cylinder, but the key details needed to price it correctly in Lagos (LPG type, 12.5kg capacity, remaining content, valve/leak safety, and certification/expiry) are not shown in the provided shots. Without those proof points, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
